reason: Both CIFs parse and symmetry-expand in I222 to fully occupied Li6Au8O8 conventional cells (22 atoms, Z=2) and primitive Li3Au4O4 cells (11 atoms); they are distinct ordered realizations. Indexing is strong and no important observed reflection is unexplained. However, neither atomic model is sufficiently established by intensities: the trace gives instantiated whole-profile residuals of 0.13255 and 0.13121, far above the 0.03425 free-line/profile lower bound and about 0.0175 expected from the measured baseline noise. Unconstrained coordinate refinements improve the fit only by producing impossible O-O contacts of 1.26-1.36 A and Au-O contacts of 1.61-1.65 A, whereas both submitted refinements terminate exactly at the imposed O-O = 2.100 A constraint and the alternative also at Li-Li = 2.000 A. Full neighbor shells show no fatal overlap in the submitted CIFs, but chemistry constraints are materially selecting their coordinates rather than corroborating a convergent diffraction solution. The two Li-ordering branches cover the identified discrete ordering ambiguity, yet the large atomic-intensity gap and lack of independent coordinate convergence leave materially different periodic realizations viable, so another solution attempt is warranted.
